mission.title: Redpill Redux
mission.description: Rescue a Zion recruit from counterfeit Agents.

npc.say: Rescue him? You have other things to worry about.

phase.briefing: Renegades masquerading as our operatives are attacking a human recruitment team. It is in our best interests right now to protect this team from the renegade programs.

enter.say: Additional information is arriving... the renegade programs have destroyed the Zion recruitment team. I am updating your task accordingly. Destroy the counterfeit Agents and extract the recruit from the area.

objective.text: Get the key from Agent Long

done.say: The renegade who you just killed appears to have been carrying some sort of key.
That was good work, operative. These renegade groups are becoming increasingly impertinent.

talk.say: Those things slaughtered the operatives who were sent to take me to Zion. Can you show me where I need to go? I want to train with Zion and become strong, like you. Then I'll make the Machines pay for their actions today.

objective.text: Lead Dalton Jacobus out of the building

phase.briefing: You will now take Dalton Jacobus to the extraction point.

done.say: You can leave the recruit there.

mission.finish: It is unfortunate that these imposter Agents are causing discord between Zion and the Machines. We will take steps in the future to ensure that this deception does not continue.
